name: 불씨 이오네
body_structure: 반투명한 불꽃의 형태와 황금 장식의 결합
hair: 흐르는 듯한 유동적인 불꽃 형태의 머리카락
skin: 짙은 오렌지색과 화이트 에너지가 섞인 피부
outfit: 화려한 황금 갑주와 붉은색 비단 망토
silhouette: 머리의 거대한 태양 왕관, 등 뒤의 날카로운 빛의 날개, 거대한 구체 무기, 길게 뻗은 불꽃 꼬리
signature_motion: 공중으로 떠오르며 주변에 강력한 빛의 파동을 방출함
signature_vfx: 황금빛 태양 입자가 소용돌이치며 흩어지는 효과
visual_en: A 2-head tall chibi flame entity facing right. The head features a large golden solar crown with small embedded jewels and glowing golden horns. The eyes are brilliant white-yellow sparks. The hair is composed of flowing, vibrant orange and deep red flames. On the back, sharp wings made of white light fragments expand wide. The body is a translucent deep orange, wearing heavy, lavish golden armor with sun engravings. A long, flowing cape of crimson silk trails behind, accompanied by a bright, flickering flame tail. The character holds a massive, radiant golden solar orb that emits intense white light. Golden bracelets adorn the arms, and the feet are composed of pure, bright yellow fire.
pose_en: Floating regally while gripping a massive orb, looking down with pride.
vfx_en: Swirling golden solar particles and intense white light flares.
lore: 보스 공통 패턴만 있다(돌진·탄막·예고 장판·졸개 소환). 생김새와 성격은 자유.

anim_notes.skill: firing a barrage of glowing bullets outward
anim_notes.ultimate: slamming a glowing warning circle onto the ground and summoning minions
anim_notes.vfx: a glowing red warning circle on the ground

frame_notes.hit_0: Every part of the character and every effect ends well inside the picture, with empty background visible along all four edges. The fireball stays small and close to the body

body_plan.body: A small, humanoid character with fiery hair, golden armor, and white wings, holding a ball of fire.
